basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Links a learner to programmes, results and awards, not the programme or qualification definitions.
Personal awards and credentials are verifiable records, distinct from self-declared skills.
Recognition and comparability assertions are recorded with their issuer.
Professional licences are referenced, not owned.

may: Verify credentials through the issuer or a verification service.
Help learners collect and share their records.
Explain how a qualification compares within published frameworks.
mustNot: Make admission or hiring decisions from records alone.
Treat an unverified credential as verified.

considerations: Credentials open or close access to jobs and further study.
Records of minors need extra protection.
Credential fraud harms honest learners and the public.

items: A learner record names a person, an institution, a programme, results and awards with dates and issuers.
It is confused with a CV entry, a course enrolment and a professional licence.
Disclosure of grades or special needs data.
European Learning Model and Europass digital credentials.
